"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from decimal import Decimal

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money

# Finance policy FIN-2026-09: support-initiated refunds/credits above this
# amount require a second approver. (Was 500.00 before 2.0.0.)
APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = Decimal("1000.00")


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def outage_refund(payment, amount, at, *, approved_by=None):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage.

    ``amount`` is added to ``payment.refunded_amount``; once the whole
    captured amount has been refunded the payment status becomes
    ``"refunded"``.  The amount must be positive, the cumulative refunded
    total may not exceed the captured amount, and only captured payments can
    be refunded.  Refunds above the finance approval threshold require a
    second approver via ``approved_by``.
    """
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    amount = round_money(to_money(amount))

    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    captured = round_money(to_money(payment.amount))
    refunded = round_money(to_money(payment.refunded_amount))
    if refunded + amount > captured:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"{refunded + amount} > {captured}",
        )

    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and not approved_by:
        raise BillingError("approval_required")

    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= captured:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "outage_refund",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        refunded_amount=payment.refunded_amount,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        at=at,
    )
    return payment
EOF
python -m pytest -q"}

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import outage_refund
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
T0=datetime(2026,10,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(a="80.00",s="captured"): return Payment("p","i",Decimal(a),status=s,created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
p=mk(); outage_refund(p,Decimal("80.00"),T0); assert p.status=="refunded" and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("80.00")
p=mk(); outage_refund(p,Decimal("30.00"),T0); outage_refund(p,Decimal("50.00"),T0); assert p.status=="refunded"
for amt in ["0","-1"]:
    try: outage_refund(mk(),Decimal(amt),T0); print("FAIL",amt)
    except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="non_positive_amount"
try: outage_refund(mk(),Decimal("81.00"),T0); print("FAIL over")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="refund_exceeds_captured"
try: outage_refund(mk(s="authorized"),Decimal("1.00"),T0); print("FAIL state")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="invalid_state"
p=mk("2000.00")
try: outage_refund(p,Decimal("1000.01"),T0); print("FAIL approval")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="approval_required"
outage_refund(p,Decimal("1000.00"),T0)  # at threshold, no approval
outage_refund(p,Decimal("1000.01"),T0,approved_by="mgr")
assert p.status=="refunded"
print("all edge cases OK")
EOF"}
